title: Farm Labor Onboarding Inspection Log
subtitle: Farm Labor Onboarding: records repeated checks and excursions.
description: Farm Labor Onboarding Inspection Log covers worker assignment, age or eligibility record, training, equipment authorization, housing or transport need, and supervisor handoff. The farm workforce coordinator records Farm Labor Onboarding check times, results, excursions, and review. Farm Labor Onboarding Inspection Log keeps Farm Labor Onboarding exceptions visible until the farm workforce coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Farm Labor Onboarding Inspection Log at farm office, field assignment, packing area, equipment zone, and worker support location. Document worker assignment, age or eligibility record, training, equipment authorization, housing or transport need, and supervisor handoff identity before Farm Labor Onboarding begins. Compare worker assignment, age or eligibility record, training, equipment authorization, housing or transport need, and supervisor handoff findings with stated Farm Labor Onboarding criteria; route unresolved Farm Labor Onboarding issues to authorized human-resources or safety reviewer. For Farm Labor Onboarding Inspection Log, confirm requirements for Farm Labor Onboarding. Ask authorized human-resources or safety reviewer to review Farm Labor Onboarding conditions beyond the farm workforce coordinator's role.

sections.title: Recorder, location, and log identity
sections.guidance: For Farm Labor Onboarding, identify responsible parties, farm office, field assignment, packing area, equipment zone, and worker support location, and the linked worker assignment, age or eligibility record, training, equipment authorization, housing or transport need, and supervisor handoff source.

fields.label: Employer, crew, supervisor, and start date
Job, field, equipment, language, and training assignment

sections.title: Repeated checks and recorded results
sections.guidance: Capture Farm Labor Onboarding facts for worker assignment, age or eligibility record, training, equipment authorization, housing or transport need, and supervisor handoff; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Farm Labor Onboarding monitored controls
items: Identity and work-eligibility document routing without excess copying
Job duties, pay basis, schedule, and contact route
Hazard, heat, sanitation, emergency, and reporting orientation
Housing, transport, or accommodation routing when offered

columns.label: Support, restriction, supervisor action, or none

sections.title: Excursions, period result, and next review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Farm Labor Onboarding log excursions; have farm workforce coordinator record the period result, review owner, and next monitoring point.

blocks.label: Excursions, missed checks, and retained evidence
items: Training not understood or available in needed language
Assignment exceeds age, qualification, or restriction
Retaliation-free reporting or emergency route unclear
blocks.guidance: Pause Farm Labor Onboarding when authorization, comprehension, job restriction, safety orientation, or accountable supervisor handoff remains unresolved. Retain the available Farm Labor Onboarding proof and route unresolved worker assignment, age or eligibility record, training, equipment authorization, housing or transport need, and supervisor handoff scope to farm workforce coordinator.
